# `eutaxy/spec`

`import { … } from "eutaxy/spec";` 3 functions and values, 4 types; each links to the file that declares it.

## Functions, classes and values

### `forall`

`function forall<F extends Fn>(fn: F, property: { readonly sample?: (...args: Parameters<F>) => boolean; readonly when?: (...args: Parameters<F>) => boolean; readonly ensures: (...args: Parameters<F>) => boolean; }): Forall<F>`

Claim that `ensures` holds for every input of `fn` where `when` holds; `sample` narrows only the inputs the `TESTED` rung draws. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

### `isSpec`

`function isSpec(value: unknown): value is Spec`

Whether a spec file's export is one of the two spec shapes. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

### `total`

`function total<F extends Fn>(fn: F): Total<F>`

Claim that `fn` terminates on every input of its parameter types; only an engine can establish it. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

## Types

### `Fn`

`type Fn`

Any function; `never[]` so that every parameter list is accepted. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

### `Forall`

`interface Forall`

A universally quantified claim: for every input of `fn`'s parameter types where `when` holds, `ensures` holds. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

### `Spec`

`type Spec`

A spec file's export: a `forall` claim or a `total` claim. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)

### `Total`

`interface Total`

The claim that `fn` terminates on every input of its parameter types. [Source](https://github.com/Kaisenwerk/eutaxy/blob/main/packages/spec/src/combinators.ts)
